verdict.rationale: Apple's newsroom offers only marketing claims: Xcode builds and multi-simulator testing are 'quicker than ever' and M4 Pro gives 'stunning performance' for large code bases. The pack has no spec-level CPU data and no independent hands-on results; the community items only ask how it compares to M3 and include no benchmark numbers. Missing for 10: documented core counts (performance vs. efficiency), clock/boost behavior, sustained multi-core behavior under load, independent multi-core or compile-time benchmarks.
